reasoning_content: HTTPS works with self-signed Traefik default cert (since Let's Encrypt can't issue for localhost, Traefik falls back to default self-signed). Let's check the frontend page content and administration.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "echo \"=== frontend ===\"; curl -sS -k https://localhost/ | head -c 600; echo; echo \"=== admin ===\"; curl -sS -k -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\\n\" https://localhost/administration; echo \"=== docs (basic auth) ===\"; curl -sS -k -o /dev/null -w \"no-auth=%{http_code}\\n\" https://localhost/administration/docs/; curl -sS -k -u admin:swaggerpass123 -o /dev/null -w \"auth=%{http_code}\\n\" https://localhost/administration/docs/", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Verify endpoints content"}
